body:
Mdma and capsaicin
So I had just took .2 grams of mdma. I also took mdma the night before so tolerance levels should have been risen at this point in time.
00:30 after I dropped I happen to decide for no reason at all to eat 4 hot as hell peppers with my Quin Wah I had just made.
00:45 what ensues next was nothing less than what I would imagine a 800-1000 microgram LSD trip for about the next hour.
I was tripping sack meaning that the universe dissolved into shimmering atoms flowing in a sort of melting patrern around me. It was quite intense at the time because it was fully unexpected.
Had I known I was in for such a ride I would have taken it far more smoothly I'm sure.
